live2d.description: The Live2D Studio lists models from a validated associated catalog and opens them in the browser viewer. Load a path-safe model ID when its catalog data, assets, and runtime are available.
live2d.modelSelector.description: Browse models from the validated associated catalog below or type any path-safe model ID to open its viewer route. Listed entries include model, body-motion, and facial-motion metadata; loading still depends on the browser runtime and asset access.
live2d.modelSelector.inputError: That model ID is not path-safe. Use letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only.
live2d.modelSelector.inputHint: Letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores. Unknown IDs show an unavailable state after the catalog is checked.
live2d.modelSelector.characterNavigation: Choose a character to view its models
live2d.modelSelector.model.preview01.des: Catalog model metadata is validated before browser loading.
live2d.modelSelector.model.preview02.des: Catalog model metadata is validated before browser loading.
live2d.modelSelector.model.sample.descri: Browser viewer entry checked against the validated associated catalog before loading.
live2d.modelSelector.model.sample.title: Catalog model
live2d.modelSelector.title: Model catalog
live2d.modelViewer.controls.hint: Choose body motions and facial expressions after the model loads.
live2d.modelViewer.controls.title: Playback controls
live2d.modelViewer.description: Load one catalog-validated Cubism model on a dedicated stage and use separate body and facial motion controls. Model loading still depends on the browser runtime, approved Core provenance, model assets, and deployed-origin access.
live2d.modelViewer.stage.reserved: Model stage initializes with the browser viewer.
live2d.modelViewer.status.description: The validated associated catalog supplies model, body-motion, and facial-motion metadata. The browser adapter loads a model when its assets and runtime are available; unavailable states remain explicit.
live2d.modelViewer.status.label: Viewer status
live2d.modelViewer.status.title: Model viewer status
live2d.modelViewer.status.unavailableDes: The validated associated catalog may be unavailable or may not provide a loadable descriptor for this route. Playback stays disabled when model assets, approved Cubism Core provenance, deployed-origin CORS, or browser runtime support is unavailable.
live2d.modelViewer.stage.unavailable: Model stage unavailable — catalog, assets, or browser runtime could not load the model.
live2d.modelViewer.title: Model Viewer
live2d.title: Live2D Model Viewer
